provenance_note: Hand-authored; no tenant contacted. The AUD-H-004 unattributable case: this receive line carries NO line_item_id, so nothing links it to a PO line. Section 11.8 requires this to become a GRN_LINE_UNATTRIBUTED exception accumulating in unattributed_receipts_paise -- never spread pro-rata, never silently dropped. The DTO must therefore expose purchase_order_line_external_id=None rather than inventing one from line position.
